images.title: Three steps down the power line of 4
images.purpose: Shows the powers of 4 from 4³ to 4⁸ on a line, with 65536 ÷ 64 as a move of 3 steps down from 4⁸ to 4⁵.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One horizontal line with six evenly spaced dots and one curved arrow going back.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal line in dark outline with exactly 6 evenly spaced teal (#0072B2) dots for 4³, 4⁴, 4⁵, 4⁶, 4⁷ and 4⁸ from left to right. Only three dots carry labels below them: the first 4³ = 64, the third 4⁵ = 1024, the sixth 4⁸ = 65536. Small dark arrows between neighbouring dots, with one label × 4 each step above the line at the left. One amber (#E69F00) curved arrow above the line from the 4⁸ dot back to the 4⁵ dot, labelled ÷ 64: 3 steps down. The 4⁵ dot is reddish purple (#CC79A7). Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: On a power line, dividing by 4³ moves 3 steps down: 65536 ÷ 64 = 4⁵.
images.description: Shows the powers of 4 from 4³ to 4⁸ on a line, with 65536 ÷ 64 as a move of 3 steps down from 4⁸ to 4⁵.

image_decisions.why: The power line turns dividing powers into counting steps.
